dogecoin.text:
Doge has its own L1?

Yes, DogeCoin has a fully functional L1 that supports DRC-20 tokens (meme coins) and Doginals (NFTs)

The Doge ecosystem mirrors Bitcoin’s in many ways -no surprise since Dogecoin forked from Luckycoin, which forked from Litecoin, a direct fork of Bitcoin

DogeCoin is already massive at $54B MC...

It’ll run this cycle with Elon and D.O.G.E - no doubt

But the hidden gem? Its ecosystem: NFTs and memes on the L1 that almost no one knows about 🐶

The Top Doge L1 Coin only sits at $11M MC - lets dive in 🧵 https://t.co/M5SZQimAE3
